archive: Warren Buffett / Berkshire investment-relevant public statements (not X posts)
method: Exa /contents primary-source retrieval; webSearch discovery; queryWithLLM candidate extraction; each retained excerpt matched literally after whitespace normalization against retrieved primary text. CNBC video transcripts may contain visible transcription errors.
text_format: Short continuous verbatim excerpts, NOT complete original statements. Whitespace normalized; no invented timestamps. YYYY-MM denotes known month but exact public release day unverified. Annual period is not publication date. url is source URL, never a fabricated status URL.
limitations: Partial selection, not an exhaustive utterance or trade archive. Multiple excerpts may explain one decision; do not count them as independent trades.
Later letters explain earlier decisions retrospectively; source dates control replay eligibility.
CNBC automatic transcripts preserve exposed transcription errors such as weve. Do not silently correct into a fabricated verbatim quote.
Author/speaker Abel in 2026 is not Buffett. decider:unknown for inherited transaction discussion where individual originator is not established.
Initial Apple deputy identity not established here. 2024 Apple tax rationale is not a verified BofA sale rationale.
Month-only dates are not exact timestamps and cannot be admitted to a replay inside that month without verifying publication.
